So I did something slightly unhinged last week: I gave up coffee for seven whole days. Anyone who knows me knows that this was a big deal. I usually have three cups before lunch.

Day one was rough. I had a pounding headache by ten in the morning and I was snapping at everyone, including the cat. Day two was not much better, and I seriously considered caving when I walked past the coffee shop on my way to work.

By day four, something strange happened. The headache faded, and I noticed I was waking up before my alarm. I still missed the taste, and the ritual of that warm mug in the morning, but I felt steadier. No jittery afternoon crash, no frantic search for another cup.

Would I give it up for good? Honestly, no. I love coffee too much. But the experiment taught me that I had been leaning on it more than I realized. I am now down to one cup a day, and I actually enjoy it more. Sometimes a little break is exactly what you need to appreciate something again.
